title: Serve the effective built-in AI provider (and where it came from) so the first-run checklist can offer a "Set up the built-in AI" step
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzge87Pae2h7uSQzX8H

Filing gate: **④ coordination child**, the server half of #32021 item 4. #32021 keeps the console half (the checklist step), which waits on this card.

## 维护者速读

新装的私有部署里，客户最先想用的是内置 AI（设置 → AI 与向量化：选提供商、填密钥），但首次使用清单里没有这一步。控制台加不了这一步，因为它读不到「内置 AI 现在到底有没有配好」：服务端会从环境变量自动识别提供商，而设置里看到的「未配置」并不代表 AI 关着。这张卡让服务端只读地报出当前实际生效的提供商和来源，控制台才能如实画出这一步。

## What the console cannot read today (seat reading at `origin/main` `e627eaa1`)

- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:5266-5268`: "AIServicePlugin auto-detects its LLM provider from environment (AI_GATEWAY_MODEL, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY)".
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/ai.manifest.ts:248-250`: the reset action "clears every saved row in this namespace so the runtime falls back to env auto-detection".
- So `GET /api/settings/ai` answering `provider: null` (since #32010) means "nothing saved in settings", not "the built-in AI is off". A checklist step drawn from that read would say "not set up" on a box whose AI works.
- Measured by the #32021 card thread (os-dev report 6758131226, PR #32050): it shipped the checklist wording and held the step back for this reason.

## Expected

A read-only answer the console can use, behind the same gate as the AI settings page: the provider that is actually in effect (or none) and its source (`settings` | `environment` | `none`). The lane names the door (a field on the settings read or a status route). ⛔ No secret, key or key prefix in the answer.

## Who acts next

`domain:server` builds the read. Then `domain:ui` adds the checklist step on #32021 ("Set up the built-in AI", linking Setup → AI & Embedder, done when the source is not `none`).

## Business reason

A licensed self-hosted customer's first wish is the built-in AI; without a faithful status the checklist either omits the step (today) or shows a false "not set up".

Dedupe: `is:issue "effective provider"` → 3 hits (#32021, #3391, #27119), none on this; `is:issue AI provider auto-detect environment settings` → 2 (#32021, #1070 closed: the auto-detect itself). None.
